scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:staging: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:staging -w server"
scripts.dev:production: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:production -w server"
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run deploy:server:staging && npm run deploy:client:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run deploy:server && npm run deploy:client
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:staging && npm run deploy:production
